headline: SecMark Consultancy incorporates wholly-owned subsidiary SecMark Financial Aggregation Private Limited
sum: SecMark Consultancy Limited has incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary (WOS) named SecMark Financial Aggregation Private Limited, disclosed via NSE Regulation 30 filing on 12 August 2026, following board approval on 3 July 2026.
implication: WOS incorporation by listed entities triggers materiality disclosure under SEBI LODR; the 40-day lag between board approval (3 July) and public disclosure (12 August) warrants review of the company's disclosure timeline compliance under Regulation 30.
detail: SecMark Consultancy Limited, a listed company, announced the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary under the Companies Act, 2013. The subsidiary, SecMark Financial Aggregation Private Limited, was incorporated following Board approval on 3 July 2026. The disclosure was mandated under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, Regulation 30 (material events and information). No acquisition value or consideration is disclosed—this is a greenfield subsidiary incorporation rather than an M&A transaction.
